summary: Financial and compliance health check, quality of earnings and working capital review, with key risks ranked.
metaTitle: Financial Due Diligence Support for Buyers and Founders
metaDescription: Financial and compliance due diligence support: health check, quality of earnings, working capital review, tax and statutory exposure and a ranked risk report.
heroIntro: Know what you are buying or selling: a focused review of the numbers and compliance behind a deal or fundraise.
overview: Investors, buyers and lenders ask hard questions. Whether you are preparing to be diligenced or reviewing a target, we assess the quality of reported earnings, working capital and compliance exposure and rank the key risks.
whatWeDo: Quality of earnings and working capital review.
Findings report with key risks ranked.
whoFor: Businesses applying for large bank facilities.

faqs.a: No. It is a focused advisory review. We do not perform statutory audit or tax audit.

faqs.q: Can you help us prepare for investor diligence?
faqs.a: Yes. A pre-diligence review finds and fixes issues before an investor does.
